stable.notes: v0.43.0: the pinout diagram belongs to the housing (Housings tab gets the pinout box, canvas resolves connector -> housing, two connectors on one housing share one pinout); nets in the node dialog - Net band on the wire table, Group by Net / Function / Connector / Remote device / Wire part with collapsible groups, search, Node switch, Matrix tab; blank wire rows are saved and never vanish; Add Device offers every cavity of the new connectors as a wire row. Needs the 2026-09-22_pinout_to_housing.sql catalog migration (and 2026-09-22_housing_cavities.sql from v0.42.0).

beta.notes:
New menus, one subject each: File, Edit, View, Harness, Place, Tools, Build, Database, Help. Every panel sits in one menu under its own name (Project Properties, Undo History, Wire Tools, Program Log, ...). Settings is in File. Shortcuts are unchanged.
Toolbar: Place, Orbit Mode, View, Parts Database. View opens View Settings for the selected nodes (Apply to Selected) or for every node (Apply All).
Build menu: Cut List, Wire Checklist, Boot & Heat-Shrink Schedule | Bill of Materials, Build Time Report, Build Time Rates | Export HTML Document, Print Build Board 1:1.
Wire Tools: "Fill ... from ..." buttons, Rows, and Re-establish Split Wires (whole harness, result in Results).
Design Rule Check: new rule "Splice cross section" (joined wires summed like the terminal rule). The node dialog's DRC band shows every finding and refreshes on each save.
No new database migrations (the 2026-09-24 ones from 0.45.0 are still required before stable).
